{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Filter for converted customers
converted_customers = df[df['converted'] == 1]

# Filter out invalid age values (-1)
valid_ages = converted_customers[converted_customers['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute mean age
mean_age = valid_ages['customer_age'].mean()

# Also compute counts for transparency
n_converted = len(converted_customers)
n_valid_ages = len(valid_ages)
n_invalid_ages = n_converted - n_valid_ages

mean_age, n_converted, n_valid_ages, n_invalid_ages"}
